ValidationRule.description: Ensures the Disposition is required when a case is updated from Investigation to Closed, and that the Investigation has a Status of Recommend to Close. Also checks that all Case Contacts have an Allegation, and that all Allegations have a Violation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Closed" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status__c) , "Investigation" ),
OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Disposition__c)),
Investigation_Status_Recommend_to_Close__c < 1,
Total_of_Allegations__c != Total_of_Allegation_Violations__c,
Total_of_Case_Contacts__c != Total_of_Case_Contact_Allegations__c)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill out the Disposition when updating a case from Investigation to Closed, and ensure that the Investigation status is set to Recommend to Close. Please also confirm that all Case Contacts have Allegations, and all Allegations have Violations.
